kind.description: Required entry kind: dir must exist as a directory, file must exist as a file.

file_structure.description: Existence-only entries enforced by this blueprint (no content compare).

ignore.description: Top-level keys excluded from the compare; local values are preserved by fix.

pinned.description: Top-level keys that must match the golden (objects merge per key, so local extras are allowed); fix takes golden values.

strip.description: Top-level keys removed from both sides before comparing and from fix output.

versioned.description: Object sections (e.g. dependencies) where versions must match for packages present on both sides; fix takes golden versions.

compare.description: Semantic compare/fix rules for this file.

source.description: Source path of the golden file. Relative to the manifest directory when starting with ./ or ../, otherwise relative to the tech-stack root.

github.description: Source path of the GitHub settings preset. Relative to the manifest directory when starting with ./ or ../, otherwise relative to the tech-stack root.

dependencies.description: Packages required in dependencies, pinned to exact versions; "any" allows any installed version.

devDependencies.description: Packages required in devDependencies, pinned to exact versions; "any" allows any installed version.

peerDependencies.description: Packages required in peerDependencies, pinned to exact versions; "any" allows any installed version.

pm.description: Package manager binary used in install hints, e.g. bun.
